meta.title: AgentBridge — Secure Local Terminal Connector Architecture
meta.subtitle: Native Shell-Less Subprocess Dispatch, Workspace Confinement, Policy Boundaries & Clean Process Cleanup
meta.description: System architecture of Phase 7.8B Secure Local Terminal Connector in AgentBridge. Illustrates caller dispatch via CLI and autonomous runtime agents, lifecycle management in ConnectorRegistry, shell-less validation in TerminalConnector, path confinement within authorized workspace roots, PolicyEngine risk evaluation and CRITICAL invariant enforcement, WorkspaceLockManager concurrency protection, controlled environment sanitization, native asynchronous process supervision (asyncio.create_subprocess_exec), deep process-tree termination on timeout/cancellation, and secret redaction across ActivityStore history.

components.label:
AgentBridge CLI & Autonomous Runtime
(sutra/connectors/cli.py)
components.description: CLI commands (sutra connectors add/test/status/tools) and autonomous agent workflows invoking canonical connector requests.

components.label:
ConnectorRegistry
(sutra/connectors/registry.py)
components.description: Central coordinator registering terminal-local as ConnectorType.CLI with provider 'terminal', storing persistent non-secret metadata in SQLite.

components.label:
TerminalConnector
(sutra/connectors/terminal/connector.py)
components.description: Canonical Connector contract implementation managing lifecycle (READY/DISCONNECTED), concurrency semaphores, request parsing, and execution.

components.label:
Command Safety Validator
(sutra/connectors/terminal/security.py)
components.description: Enforces strict shell-less argument boundary validation, rejecting chaining operators (; && || | > <), command substitutions ($() ``), and wrapper scripts (bash -c, cmd /c, powershell -Command).

components.label:
Workspace Confinement Guard
(sutra/security.py)
components.description: Canonicalizes working directories, verifies confinement within authorized workspace roots, rejects filesystem roots and relative traversal (..) escapes.

components.label:
PolicyEngine & PermissionEngine
(sutra/policy_engine.py)
components.description: Authoritative security boundary assessing risk levels (LOW/HIGH/CRITICAL), auto-approving safe read-only queries, enforcing session grants, and guarding CRITICAL invariants.

components.label:
WorkspaceLockManager
(sutra/workspace_lock.py)
components.description: Coordinates granular shared-read and exclusive-write directory locks to prevent overlapping destructive mutations across concurrent sessions.

components.label:
Controlled Environment Policy
(sutra/connectors/terminal/security.py)
components.description: Constructs minimal subprocess environments based on platform whitelists (SAFE_ENV_WHITELIST_NT / POSIX), stripping parent process secrets and API tokens.

components.label:
Native Subprocess Supervisor
(asyncio.create_subprocess_exec)
components.description: Spawns native asynchronous child processes strictly with shell=False, piping stdout/stderr and binding stdin to DEVNULL with bounded byte caps.

components.label:
Process Tree Terminator
(sutra/connectors/terminal/security.py)
components.description: Safely terminates child process and all descendants on timeout or cancellation (taskkill /F /T on Windows, terminate -> kill on POSIX), eliminating zombie leaks.

components.label:
Centralized Redaction Engine
(sutra/redaction.py)
components.description: Sanitizes private keys, auth headers, and bearer tokens from stdout/stderr, arguments, and diagnostic payloads before persistence.

components.label:
ActivityStore
(sutra/activity_store.py)
components.description: SQLite operational audit history recording tool call start, redacted arguments, completion status, duration, and error codes correlated by universal request_id.

components.label:
Metrics Subsystem
(sutra/metrics.py)
components.description: Records low-cardinality counters (terminal_commands_executed) and latency metrics.

components.label:
Local Host Operating System
(Windows / macOS / Linux)
components.description: Local machine environment executing authorized binary tools inside designated workspace.
